senses.gloss:
पंक्ति

PAṀKTI . A horse which draws the chariot of sūrya. There are seven horses to draw the chariot. The others are gāyatrī, bṛhatī, uṣṇik, jagatī, Triṣṭubh and Anuṣṭubh. (Chapter 8, aṁśa 2, viṣṇu purāṇa).

पांशु

PĀṀŚU . An ancient country of bhārata. vasudāna, king of this country helped the pāṇḍavas in the great battle with twentysix elephants and two thousand horses (Śloka 27, Chapter 52, Sabhā Parva).

पनस

PANASA . A soldier of the army of monkeys of Śrī rāma. This soldier was the commander-in-chief of an army of fiftyone crores of monkeys who fought against rāvaṇa. His chief object of attack was the army of a demon named paṭuśa. (Chapter 283, Vana Parva).

पानिमान्

PĀNIMĀN . A serpent. This serpent is a member of the court of varuṇa. (Śloka 10, Chapter 9, Sabhā Parva).

पंकदिग्धांग

PAṄKADIGDHĀṄGA . A deva who fought bravely against the asuras along with subrahmaṇya. (Śloka 68, Chapter 45, śalya Parva).

पंकजित्

PAṄKAJIT . Son of garuḍa. (Śloka 10, Chapter 101, Udyoga Parva).
